errors.slug_taken: That workspace URL is already taken.
errors.slug_reserved: That workspace URL is reserved and cannot be used.

new_page.title: Welcome to Multica
new_page.description: One workspace where you and your AI teammates work side by side — taking issues, leaving comments, sharing the same context.
new_page.invite_hint: You can invite teammates once your workspace is ready.

creation_disabled.title: Workspace creation is disabled
creation_disabled.description: This Multica instance does not allow new workspaces to be created. Ask your administrator for an invitation to an existing workspace.

no_access.title: Workspace not available
no_access.description: This workspace doesn't exist or you don't have access.
no_access.sign_in_different: Sign in as a different user

tab.title: Linked workspaces
tab.description: Let another workspace read the status of chosen projects without joining this one. They see project progress, task status and project context — never task descriptions, comments, attachments or private items.
tab.outgoing_description: The other workspace's owner or admin has to accept before anyone there can see anything.
tab.incoming_description: Accepted links appear in the sidebar under Linked workspaces for every member except guests.
tab.incoming_empty: No workspace is linked in yet.
tab.target_placeholder: Paste their workspace link, or type its slug
tab.projects_label: Which of this workspace's projects they can see
tab.no_shareable_projects: This workspace has no shareable projects. Private projects can never be shared.
tab.create_hint: They can read each ticked project's description, repositories, local directory paths and project memory, and so can their agents. Private tasks and projects stay hidden.
tab.need_target: Pick the workspace to share with first.
tab.create_reason: Only the owner can share this workspace's data.
tab.accept_reason: Only an owner or admin can accept or disconnect a link.
tab.created: Link offered. It starts working once they accept.
tab.pending_hint: Accept to let this workspace's members read the shared projects.
tab.active_hint: Members can read the shared projects under Linked workspaces.
tab.revoke_description: {{name}} loses sight of the shared projects on its next read. The audit trail stays.
tab.pull_projects_label: Which of their projects to see
tab.pull_need_target: Pick the workspace to read from first.
tab.pull_need_owner: You don't own that workspace. Ask its owner to offer the link from there.
tab.pull_no_projects: That workspace has no shareable projects.
tab.pull_hint: Works right away; members can read it.
tab.pull_reason: Only an owner or admin can link another workspace in.
tab.pull_created: Linked. Members can read it in the sidebar now.
tab.managed_label: Let the viewing side manage tasks and autopilots
tab.managed_hint_outgoing: When on, their agents can change tasks and autopilots here for the person who started the run.
tab.managed_hint_incoming: When on, agents here can change their tasks and autopilots for the person who started the run.
tab.managed_reason: Only an owner of the sharing workspace can switch this.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.description: Every offer, change, acceptance and disconnect. Owners on both sides can read it.

panel.title: Linked workspaces
panel.description: Read-only status of projects other workspaces share with you
panel.empty_body: When another workspace shares projects and an owner or admin here accepts, they show up here.
panel.gone_title: This link is no longer visible
panel.gone_body: It may have been disconnected, or the projects were unshared.
panel.managed_from: {{name}} allows managed access: agents can work on its tasks and autopilots for you
